evidence_scope: public renderer-neutral GUI.Forms contracts and named M12-P28 through M12-P35 experiments; adapter status remains distinct from primitive availability

construction.generated-material-parts.evidence: focused GUI.Forms material tests prove bounded pointer/count stop, fill, shadow, border, and retained ownership used by the current Stage 2 adapter

construction.generated-control-state-rec.evidence: GUI.Forms ButtonBase owns a validated retained ControlStateRecipes set; focused tests prove normal, hot, pressed, disabled, whole-visual translation, and external focus geometry
construction.generated-control-state-rec.fallback: use the named GUI.Forms theme role and report the authored-state loss

construction.generated-native-tree.evidence: experimental Stage 2 composes only exact manifest-backed material, layout, typography, state, and decoration projections into one deterministic typed retained tree
construction.generated-native-tree.fallback: none; refuse the entire tree when any retained node cannot be projected

control.command-overflow.evidence: CommandOverflowPanel now owns bounded whole-group priority collapse, focus protection, a conditionally layout-collapsed overflow actuator, stable-ID projection snapshots, and Web.Forms metadata lowering; popup command composition remains consumer domain logic
control.command-overflow.fallback: none; source must author unique group priorities and an explicit actuator

control.connected-topology.evidence: M12-P31 proves explicit bounded ConnectedControlTopology, atomic connect_button_group, singular seams, independent focus and semantic ownership, native macOS review, and Windows cross-build; Web.Forms validates explicit group axes and direct membership and emits connect_button_group without coordinate inference

control.dropdown-button.evidence: public DropDownButton retains menu or split anatomy and Web.Forms now emits the typed control directly from explicit data-wf-control/data-wf-dropdown-mode metadata with generated state materials and typography
control.dropdown-button.fallback: ordinary Button only when source does not require disclosure semantics

control.split-seam-geometry.evidence: M12-P32 proves bounded SplitSeamGeometry and physical proximity behavior; Web.Forms now validates and lowers explicit two-pane orientation, ownership, geometry, constraints, collapse policy, threshold, and transition duration into a typed SplitContainer
control.split-seam-geometry.fallback: none; legacy width setters cannot represent asymmetric physical proximity policy

decoration.after.evidence: Control owns bounded after-content decoration; owner-relative anchors, rotation, symmetric ordering, semantic exclusion, and atomic invalid rejection have focused coverage
decoration.after.fallback: none for semantic geometry; explicit text separator may be authored separately

decoration.before.evidence: Control owns bounded before-content decoration in a retained paint layer; focused native and generated-code tests prove ordering with the symmetric after-content layer

effect.bounded-shadow.evidence: SurfaceMaterial bounded outer shadows are generated exactly, retained in display chunks, and covered by material and damage tests

effect.inset-shadow.evidence: SurfaceMaterial retains inset identity; display chunks preserve it and a pixel-checked Skia CPU smoke test proves the live rounded complement remains clipped to its owner

geometry.rounded-corners.evidence: generated SurfaceMaterial corner radii retain rounded clip, fill, border, focus, and shadow geometry

host.active-window-state.evidence: M12-P29 proves HostActivationEvent updates retained Window active state and authored material can distinguish active and inactive chrome without disabling content
host.active-window-state.fallback: base active material with reported inactive-state loss

host.custom-chrome-drag-regions.evidence: M12-P29 proves plural stable-ID drag regions and exact retained hit resolution; Web.Forms now emits the authored IDs as typed generated metadata and File Manager passes that list to the full-size-content host without a product hard-code
host.custom-chrome-drag-regions.fallback: standard native title bar when the application host does not opt into full-size authored content

identity.typed-hierarchical.evidence: native tree Stage 2 requires every retained node ID, rejects normalized member collisions, emits one typed member per ID, and preserves exact StableId spelling

inspection.visual-state-snapshot.evidence: M12-P34 proves bounded renderer-neutral Window visual snapshots with stable identity, geometry, clipping, state, material, resolved text summary, committed paint, redaction, and deterministic JSON
inspection.visual-state-snapshot.fallback: none for design-time native comparison; production output need not display the inspector

layout.flex.evidence: FlowLayoutPanel publishes retained direction, wrapping, bounded gaps, alignment, padding, and per-child grow; focused tests prove live-frame center, space-between, stretch, and ratio growth

layout.grid.evidence: TableLayoutPanel publishes bounded absolute, weighted fraction, auto tracks, retained inter-track spacing, deterministic cells, and fill docking

layout.priority-collapse.evidence: M12-P33 proves authored unique collapse priorities and layout-collapsed state distinct from visibility; Web.Forms now validates and lowers explicit per-track priorities into ResponsiveTrackPanel while CommandOverflowPanel owns the separate whole-group policy
layout.priority-collapse.fallback: none; do not infer priority from DOM order or coordinates

layout.responsive-tracks.evidence: M12-P33 proves ResponsiveTrackPanel fixed, content, and weighted remaining tracks; Web.Forms now validates explicit track identity/orientation/gap/bounds/weight/priority metadata and generates typed panels, specs, and child-track relationships
layout.responsive-tracks.fallback: retain exact flex or grid lowering when source does not request responsive track semantics

motion.bounded-state-transition.evidence: GUI.Forms SplitContainer uses AnimationTimeline and bounded frame leases for inspectable 90 ms collapse-tab geometry interpolation with immediate reduced-motion substitution; Web.Forms accepts and emits bounded explicit split transition milliseconds

paint.advanced-mask-blend.evidence: M12-P28 explicitly excludes arbitrary masks, isolated groups, and general blend modes; the accepted four material specimens do not require them
paint.advanced-mask-blend.fallback: none; require a measured named specimen before admitting compositing breadth

paint.css-angle-gradient.evidence: MaterialFillLayer CSS-angle geometry resolves gradient-line endpoints from current rectangular bounds and is covered by a focused retained paint test

paint.linear-gradient.evidence: MaterialFillLayer, retained multi-stop linear gradients, and generated pointer/count stop construction are composed by native tree Stage 2

paint.ordered-fill-layers.evidence: M12-P28 proves up to eight ordered layers and Web.Forms Stage 2 now reverses bounded CSS topmost-first gradient lists into GUI.Forms back-to-front replay over the authored solid fallback; the File Manager title, shelf, location, and status specimens are generated without application material replacement
paint.ordered-fill-layers.fallback: none when authored layer order is visually significant

paint.ordered-keylines.evidence: M12-P28 proves up to eight ordered per-edge MaterialKeyline records with color, width, inset, rounded clipping, atomic validation, inspection JSON, and cross-renderer probes; Web.Forms now validates a bounded ordered edge/color/width/inset record list and lowers it into every retained material recipe for the authored node
paint.ordered-keylines.fallback: one ordinary border only when no second line on an edge is authored

paint.radial-gradient.evidence: M12-P28 proves bounded elliptical radial rendering and Web.Forms Stage 2 lowers explicit percentage ellipse radii/centres and positioned stops into normalized MaterialFillLayer geometry
paint.radial-gradient.fallback: use authored background-color only when the source declares that fallback acceptable

paint.repeating-linear-gradient.evidence: M12-P28 proves bounded logical-period replay and Web.Forms Stage 2 lowers an explicit CSS angle plus complete logical-pixel stop positions into one finite GUI.Forms repeat vector and normalized period
paint.repeating-linear-gradient.fallback: none when the repeated filament or texture is required

paint.side-border.evidence: SurfaceMaterial publishes independently retained square-edge borders; rounded edge joins and mixed shorthand cascade expansion remain refused

paint.uniform-border.evidence: SurfaceMaterial publishes a retained uniform MaterialBorder
paint.uniform-border.fallback: omit only when the authored width is zero

resource.local-png.evidence: GUI.Forms owns bounded window ImageRegistry registration and PNG is the sole admitted runtime decoder; Web.Forms now validates source-local canonical 1x/2x PNGs, intrinsic dimensions, count and byte budgets, includes their bytes in source identity, emits deterministic embedded ImageList registration, and binds authored image keys to controls

state.active.evidence: GUI.Forms retained pressed state selects generated owned recipes; Web.Forms bounds whole-visual translate state projection
state.active.fallback: base style with reported state-material degradation

state.disabled.evidence: GUI.Forms retains authored/effective enabled state independently, excludes disabled controls from focus and activation, and ButtonBase selects the generated disabled visual recipe; Web.Forms emits the bounded disabled material delta
state.disabled.fallback: base authored material only when source has no disabled-state visual requirement

state.focus-visible.evidence: Window retains keyboard, pointer, and semantic focus-cue modality independently of actual focus; ButtonBase and derived controls use it for authored focus outlines
state.focus-visible.fallback: none for the bounded button focus-visible profile

state.hover.evidence: GUI.Forms retained hot state selects generated owned recipes through its existing pointer state machine
state.hover.fallback: base style with reported state-material degradation

surface.authored-material.evidence: SurfaceMaterial plus the Control authored-background hook exist, bounded construction is measured, and the experimental generator publishes exact or refused base-surface projections
surface.authored-material.fallback: named GUI.Forms baseline role with reported loss

surface.nested-ambient-context.evidence: Stage 1 records owned and revealed edges; native tree Stage 2 applies authored layers to the same retained layout owner and clears Forms defaults before authored geometry

transform.rotate.evidence: Control owner-decoration recipes retain bounded rotation around the CSS-default box center and recompute endpoints from live owner geometry

transform.translate.evidence: generated button recipes project one bounded logical translate as a paint-only whole-visual offset with measured outsets

typography.bundled-font-pack.evidence: GUI.Forms registers exact-hash Carlito, Cousine, Portsmouth Rapids, Noto CJK, and Noto Emoji faces by stable role; Web.Forms admits only matching local font declarations

typography.resolved-runs.evidence: M12-P30 proves renderer-neutral ResolvedTextLayout and TextMetricsProvider, exact bundled primary and fallback run families, shared measurement and paint metrics, baseline snapping, inspection, native macOS review, and Windows cross-build
typography.resolved-runs.fallback: explicit estimated metrics with no fabricated family or run identity when no provider is installed

typography.retained.evidence: Label and ButtonBase retain font size, weight, italic state, letter spacing, line spacing, alignment, and bounded text case projection; Label retains foreground and wrapping
